targets.note: Invasion: the multicolor block, widely praised as one of the best draft formats of its era.
Ravnica: City of Guilds. Guild drafting, bounce lands, Glare of Subdual.
Time Spiral: timeshifted sheet, suspend, slivers. Dense and skill-testing.
Rise of the Eldrazi: the slow battlecruiser format, often named among the best draft formats ever.
Innistrad: flashback, double-faced cards, Spider Spawning.
Khans of Tarkir: wedges, morph, fetch lands in the rare slot.
Modern Masters 2017: the Ravnica-flavored cube-in-a-box, 24 packs.
Dominaria: a modern-era favorite, historic and sagas.
